item.title: Survey will aid in choosing Fairport Harbor’s official Village Flower
item.description: This online poll is being conducted by the Fairport Harbor Opportunity Development Corporation as part of its Village Flower Initiative. The nonprofit corporation described this endeavor as "a community-focused effort to select an official flower that reflects the character, values, and shared identity of Fairport Harbor."
